verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS payroll product's source is available under an open license is a fair question, since open-source payroll and HR software exists. Nothing in the evidence pack shows RUN's source being published or licensed openly. The pack covers proprietary payroll features, a paid API Central developer program and an llms.txt file, none of which is open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
